messages:
incident-bot: Pager: PROD kv-cache service (prod-us-west-2) elevated tail-latency and increased cuda OOM-like retries on inference nodes. Alerts: p95 latency > 1200ms, error rate up 3%. Trigger: continuous-batching slot growth.
lee: I'm on it. grabbing logs from the three affected pods.
lee: @maya can you join? looks like allocator churn on gpu nodes.
maya: joining. saw similar signature last week when batch upsize + prefix cache growth happened. suspect fragmentation + cuda malloc stalls.
azh: (typo) meant @zach
zach: pinged. putting a quick triage. which customer routes impacted?
lee: /v1/generate (high QPS), /chat/streaming (some sessions hitting 500ms+ token latency). enterprise-42 and a couple of PLG tenants reporting timeouts.
dashley: escalating to SEs on those accounts. told them we're investigating.
drew: reporting: enterprise-42 support ticket 9842 — multiple requests timed out, some got 503.
maya: pulling memsnap from pod-3: torch.cuda.memory_snapshot shows large numbers of reserved blocks in size classes 8MB-32MB. arena free list very fragmented. eviction rate has climbed.
lee: paste logs?
maya: ```
[2026-03-15T21:34:12Z] kv_cache: active_batches=1426 queued_tokens=1.2M
[2026-03-15T21:34:12Z] allocator: gpu_reserved=78.3GB gpu_active=71.1GB free_fragments=1.8GB slots=4302
[2026-03-15T21:34:13Z] cuda: cudaMalloc retries=12 avg_ms=42
```
zach: cudaMalloc retries and 40ms avg is classic fragmentation-induced stall. If the caching allocator can't satisfy a request it falls back to cudaMalloc which blocks.
lee: any quick mitigations besides rolling pods?
maya: options: 1) reduce batch max_tokens and concurrency to reduce peak allocations; 2) trigger per-pod process restart to free GPU cached allocations; 3) enable arena compaction (experimental flag) on runtime to fuse free spans; 4) fallback route to smaller model variant (lower mem).
lee: can we change batching config at runtime? need to limit customer impact.
maya: yes, can patch routing config. quick patch: reduce max_batch_tokens from 4096->2048 and max_inflight from 8->4 for affected model id.
lee: do it. i'll push a config hotfix now.
nashley: drafting status update for customers. include ETA for mitigation.
maya: applying patch to prod route: ```
curl -X PATCH https://controlplane/api/routes/kv-cache -d '{"max_batch_tokens":2048,"max_inflight":4}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```
incident-bot: Deploy started: route-config-update by maya (canary 3 pods -> 10 pods).
lee: monitoring. watch metrics: p95 latency, cudaMalloc retries, reserved mem.
zach: simultaneously I'll prepare a canary for a runtime flag that enables arena compaction on idle: set env KV_ARENA_COMPACT=1 (safe ramp). plan: canary on one node then roll.
maya: note: compaction increases short-term CPU and may spike latency. we'll do it on low-traffic canary pods.
lee: can we also throttle non-critical PLG tenants?
nashley: yes, enabling quota reductions for PLG slice to reduce QPS by 20%. informing affected customers in support.
drew: ticket 9842 updated with mitigation steps and ETA ~30m.
incident-bot: Canary rollout complete for route-config-update: 3/3 canary pods green; rolling to remaining.
lee: after config change, initial numbers: p95 dropped from 1200ms -> 520ms, cudaMalloc retries dropped to ~2, reserved mem stabilizing around 64GB. still seeing occasional spikes.
zach: next step: schedule rolling pod restarts staggered 30s apart to reclaim cached GPU memory. Will coordinate with maya.
maya: I'll trigger restart of affected podset in waves of 5.
lee: doing wave 1 now.
lee: wave1 done, those pods came up healthy. p95 now ~340ms on those nodes.
lee: wave2 in 10m.
nashley: drafted short postmortem note for customer comms: root cause suspicion: combination of continuous batching growth + recently increased microburst rate -> allocator fragmentation and fallback cudaMalloc stalls.
drew: customers asking if we can disable continuous batching temporarily; legal/reg teams want a hotfix.
maya: temporary disable will massively increase cost. prefer reducing batch sizes and compaction.
zach: after restarts and config patch, we're down from 3% error rate to 0.6%. still monitoring.
lee: handing on-call to zach for night with context. zach you're oncall for remaining soak.
zach: ack. I'll keep a close eye. set alert for cudaMalloc retries >5 and p95>800ms.
incident-bot: oncall handoff: lee -> zach (2026-03-15T22:10:00Z).
zach: followups: 1) schedule runtime change to enable KV_ARENA_COMPACT on low-traffic nodes tomorrow; 2) add automated rolling restarts when reserved_mem_delta > 6GB over 5m; 3) add telemetry for free fragment count and per-size-class fragmentation.
lee: filing a runbook PR with the steps we took and the hotfix commands.
nashley: customer update posted: enterprise-42 ticket 9842: we applied config patch and rolling restarts; performance improved; next steps and timeline for long-term fix.
drew: customer ops asked for ETA for full resolution -> we'll propose a patch to allocator internals (longer-term) and interim tuning.
zach: creating follow-up incident to track allocator engineering work + QA for compaction flag.
lee: thanks all. please add any logs to the incident thread. closing pager for now but leaving monitoring alert active. :thumbsup:
